final_sql: SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 LIMIT 100
